entry.title: Symposium Leiden
entry.content:
De Leidsche Flesch invited me to speak at their Symposium Cracking the Codes of the Universe. I introduced the endless battle of cryptography. Together, we took the role of Eve to crack the codes of Alice. The talk took about half an hour (my audience was very smart and understood very quickly). So, I took the opportunity to add some extra material on web certificates.

The students said they enjoyed the way I introduced the endless battle and the extra part. Obviously, I recommended them a movie and an explanation video on Enigma, you can find them in the slides 😉

entry.title: Crypto Working Group
entry.content:
The Crypto Working Group meets around four times a year to present work to each other. It is a collaboration between several Dutch universities.

When I make slides, I support my spoken text with pictures. The lack of text on the slides is suboptimal for publishing them, but it is better than nothing 😉. If you want to get a global idea of what the paper is about I would advise looking here.

entry.title: One Conference
entry.content:
The ONE Conference is Europe’s prime cybersecurity event. A leading platform for sharing knowledge, best practices and research results.

Together with the Young Talents I pitched our project at the Main stage of the One Conference, and we had a presentation on the second day of the conference.

entry.title: ICT Open
entry.content:
NWO ICT.Open brings scientists from all ICT research disciplines and industries together to learn, share ideas, and network.

I was accepted for a poster session.

entry.title: Summer School on real-world crypto and privacy

link.title: Summer School on real-world crypto and privacy

entry.content: The Summer School on real-world crypto and privacy 2025 aimed at bringing together Master/PhD students, academics and security experts from industry. The Students’ Session Talks were the talks given by participants who liked to give a little presentation.
